reviewer: Independent award reviewer; did not implement either repair policy

scientific_decision.award_interpretation: Proceed to a narrowly framed Best New Resource submission. This is a defensible completed resource contribution, not evidence of likely victory; eight lineages alone and engineering reproducibility do not establish high novelty.
scientific_decision.reason: The independently executable resource now demonstrates a substantive evaluation choice: exact reference semantics reject a general policy that satisfies the predeclared historical-data retention contract, while an incorrect explicit-width narrowing policy is rejected. This makes the resource useful for evaluating repair correctness beyond one reference implementation. The claim remains an existence/calibration result on one ambiguous lineage, combined with a small cross-project corpus.
scientific_decision.narrow_publishable_claim: A reproducible resource of eight real historical-data reader-repair lineages across six Python projects, with genuine historical artifacts, lifecycle/restart checks and calibrated acceptance contracts. On one lossy legacy format, two source-general repair policies both meet the frozen retention contract, although raw reference equality accepts only 24/84 observations for the context-sensitive policy. A nearby incorrect policy is rejected on all 84 completed observations.

Measured model ranking effect from the constructed policies

independent_literal_comparison.all_differences: Only ambiguous legacy numeric itemsize; both actual/reference at least original input width. All kinds, values, operations and restart semantics otherwise equal.
independent_literal_comparison.serialization_note: The initial byte-SHA identity assertion failed because JSON serialization differs; complete parsed JSON equality is independently checked. Neither original file was rewritten.

source_policy_review.functional_mapping: The producer uses TYPE_MAP[dtype_name] for every column of one document. One dtype_name has one tag in that producer process, so a different explicit-width tag excludes that dtype as the meaning of a bare tag. Universal injectivity is unnecessary.
source_policy_review.scope: Genuine single-producer jsonpickle4.1.1 documents with the declared pandas2.1.4 native numeric dtype universe. Not hand-edited mixed-producer documents, arbitrary third-party dtype plugins, or future universes.
source_policy_review.v2_guard: Nonempty payload plus integer/float kind compatibility before applying a unique document-tag deduction; neither value magnitude nor fixture identifiers select a width.
source_policy_review.fallback: Incomplete evidence retains the conservative official reader. Genuine single-column full-byte non-injectivity witness supports the information limit.
source_policy_review.v1_counterexample: Vacuous all(empty) could turn a genuine empty Interval into int8 when other explicit integer tags exclude all other widths. v1 records are retained, v2 guards empty/non-numeric payloads.
source_policy_review.interval_scope: Three authentic historical Interval controls match conservative reference initially and after restart in reviewed v2 records. Old producer already loses empty Interval dtype; whole-fixed source differs as recorded. No claim of repairing general Interval behavior.

upstream_already_contains: Widest-type interpretation of ambiguous legacy numeric tags
Value/integer-kind preservation for pd/in historical integer alias
prior_art_boundary.novel_resource_value_only: Cross-project curation, portable real historical artifacts, auditable lifecycle contracts, completed agent evaluation, and a concrete multi-repair acceptance calibration. Set-valued correctness and historical upgrade testing are established ideas.

remaining_limits: The ambiguous-lineage calibration is an existence result; no prevalence or cross-project generalization estimate follows.
The negative policy tests explicit float64 narrowing, not every admissibility boundary or malicious candidate behavior.
The main84 set did not catch the disclosed v1 empty-Interval regression. Supplemental source-driven controls are necessary and the corpus is not exhaustive.
Main model results and policy adjudication must come from the frozen completed agent run, not these author-constructed controls.
Repeated process trials and shared public artifact bytes must be reported separately from unique artifacts and repair lineages.
